text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having finished my work for the
morning, I'm out
for a stroll and enjoying
the sunny day, when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hey there. All finished up? Are you
headed
anywhere special?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: I totally get it. Days like this are perfect for going out. Sigh... Now I want to go somewhere too...
choice_data_list: The weather was nice, so I was just strolling around.
The weather was nice, so I was just strolling around, you know.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Howdy! Well, ain't this a nice
coincidence!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Hyah! Who's that?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Taiki? You look sad... Did something

happen?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: ...Ahhh, so your friends canceled your plans to go to the mountain stream, huh? That is a bummer.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, but they said some important stuff
came up
that they have to wrap, so what
can you do?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's great bein' able to vent when you're
feeling
blue. I'm so happy y'all were here
to lend me an
ear!
choice_data_list: Aratame probably isn't it, but that's a shame.
Aratame probably isn't it, but that's too bad.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now, bring it on in for a big thank-you
hug!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Eeek! N-n-n-now hold on a second!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh, my bad, Tannhauser! ...Not a
hugger?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah... no! That's not it! It's just that... well,
how do I
put this? It's not like I don't
like being hugged! It's
just, uh...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems less like she hates hugs and
more that
she was just caught off
guard—and feels a little
embarrassed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Regardless, Matikanetannhauser has got
herself
worked up over it, so I change
the subject in an
attempt to calm her
down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I suggest that they go to the mountain
stream
together. Matikanetannhauser
wants a day out as
well, so it should kill
two birds with one stone.
choice_data_list: If we're at a mountain stream, then—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! That sounds like a mighty fine idea!
Let's do
it!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oh, o-okay! If you're cool with hanging
out with
me, then sure! I'll go wherever.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Darn right I'm cool hanging out with you!
We're
gonna have ourselves a ball!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Man! Taiki's so nice! She says that even
though
she might've really been hurt by
my reaction to
her hug...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(But I was just a little embarrassed, that's
all.
Taiki is so straightforward with her
feelings, it
made me freeze up...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
(Gyaah! I really messed up! I should be
grateful to
that trainer for sorting out my
dumb mistake.)

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: (I'll definitely return the favor someday!)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey! Why don't you join us, Trainer? The
more
the merrier!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Great!
I'm not one bit sad now!
Hehe! Thanks a million,
Tannhauser!
choice_data_list: Let me know and I'll clear my schedule.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Of course! I'll show you how well I can
take a hug!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Matikanetannhauser seems motivated,
though it
appears she might still be hung
up about the hug.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. What we oughta do is have us a
barbecue!
Meat and veggies are extra
tasty fresh off the
grill!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Now you're talkin'! I'm sure we can round
us up a
few more heads! I'll get right on
it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle hurtles off in the blink of
an eye. I'm
watching her shrink into the
distance, when...

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Okay, Taiki! The thing about the
hug is
that it just caught me off guard!
So... huh?! Taiki?
Taikiii!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Taiki Shuttle is already gone, but

Matikanetannhauser putters around for a
little
while looking for her.
